name: artiq-http
description: MCP server and skill for controlling an ARTIQ quantum physics experiment system via its HTTP API. Provides tools for experiment discovery, submission, scheduling, and dataset access.

artiq_url.title: ARTIQ HTTP base URL
artiq_url.description: Base URL of your artiq_http deployment, without a trailing slash (e.g. https://artiq.example.com). The MCP server is served at <url>/mcp and the REST API at <url>/api.
